stages.name: Group A (championship)
stages.note: Top six, double round-robin; 36 matches in total.

stages.name: Group B (relegation)
stages.note: Bottom eight, single round-robin; 33 matches in total. Bottom three relegated.

stages.name: first phase
stages.note: Single round-robin: each club meets every other club once.

stages.name: promotion round
stages.note: Top eight, double round-robin; 29 matches in total. Top three promoted.

stages.name: relegation round
stages.note: Bottom eight, double round-robin; 29 matches in total. Bottom three relegated.

boundaries.note: Three direct places each way, decided by the second-phase tables: the bottom three of the First Division's relegation group go down, the top three of the Second Division's promotion round go up. No play-offs at this boundary.

conflicts.topic: Asymmetric split in the top flight
conflicts.detail: The First Division does not split into two equal groups: the top six play a double round-robin (10 more games, 36 total) while the bottom eight play a single round-robin (7 more, 33 total). A single round count for the division only fits one of the two groups.

conflicts.topic: Second Division points carry and it plays 29 games
conflicts.detail: The 16 clubs play each other once (15 rounds), then split into two groups of eight that each play a double round-robin (14 more). Points and goals are carried (the 2025-26 tables start with the first-phase points). A naive 'two groups of eight, 7 rounds' reading underestimates the season by half.

conflicts.topic: No play-offs anywhere in the modelled pyramid
conflicts.detail: Both divisions decide promotion and relegation by table position after the split; there is no promotion/relegation play-off in either direction.

conflicts.topic: Top flight has no relegation play-off
conflicts.detail: The bottom three of Group B are relegated directly; 12th is not spared by a play-off.

notes: Season 2026-27 in progress. Sizes 14/16 and levels match our rows. Second Division relegates three to the Third Division (not modelled); First Division / Second Division is closed upwards only at the top. Cups and UEFA competitions excluded.
